core_theory.funny_because: Deadpan documentary delivery of structural nonsense: the form (limerick) supplies the punch position and the twist, while the performer supplies only total sincerity about total triviality. The comedy is the register mismatch — administrative grief over persons of Minety — and never a wink. Adjacent limericks contradict by pure accumulation (rule of four, five, six): the catalog itself becomes the act. (Historically recursive: Stewart Lee's Pea Green Boat 2001 deconstructed Lear's Owl and the Pussycat — anti-comedy feeding on nonsense.)

doctrine.ontology: Sense is a rumor; the nonsense is documented.
doctrine.axiology: Precise grief over trivial things is the highest courtesy.

core_theory.status_model: self-serious chronicler; status from precision, never from wit
